endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of partners with advanced filtering, pagination, search capabilities, and access control. This endpoint supports advanced search using the `searchCriteria` parameter. To use advanced search, set `advancedSearch` to `true` and provide a JSON array of criteria in the `searchCriteria` parameter. Each criterion should be an object with `field`, `operator`, and `value`. Available fields include: `id`, `name`, `status`, `newEngagement`, `phone`, `website`, `shortName`, `partnerOfficeId`, `partnerOfficeName`, `partnerCategoryId`, `partnerCategoryName`, `addressCity`, `addressStateProvince`, `addressPostalCode`, `addressCountry`, `description`, `email`, `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`. Available operators include: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`. Date fields are `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`. Example: `[{"field":"name","operator":"like","value":"Foundation"},{"field":"status","operator":"is","value":"Active"}]`.
